svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Retrieval-augmented generation with open components
svg.desc: Retrieval-augmented generation with open components. 14 components in 2 groups. Connections: Documents to Loaders; Loaders to Chunking; Chunking to Embedding; Embedding to bge-m3 (embed chunks); Embedding to Qdrant (upsert); User to React; React to FastAPI (POST /chat); FastAPI to LangChain; FastAPI to Redis; LangChain to bge-m3 (embed query); LangChain to Qdrant (search); LangChain to Ollama (prompt and context); LangChain to Hosted model API (alternative); LangChain to Langfuse (traces).

text.tspan: Documents are chunked and embedded into Qdrant; a FastAPI and LangChain backend retrieves context and answers with a local Ollama model or a hosted one
